prompt:

Create a NEW distinct miniature for this map, not the same arrangement as reference 1.
Subject: A nuclear waste processing station: a compact yellow industrial gantry crane at the rear left suspends a cylindrical waste canister over a square luminous green containment pool; a horizontal yellow containment cylinder on the rear right with a tall metal processing tower, thick pipes, a few radiation waste drums in front. Concrete central walkway. Distinctive gantry-crane silhouette. Industrial yellow and radioactive green accents, dark steel.
Composition: a complete square concrete-and-steel cutaway foundation slab, seen from the exact same elevated isometric camera as reference 1, diamond-shaped in the square image; all equipment fits on this slab, 8% clear margin around the entire silhouette. Crisp 3D game asset, detailed but readable at small mobile size. Equipment along edges, central ground visible. All six pieces should have consistent scale and foundation thickness. No surrounding environment or backdrop.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the slab, including all empty corners. No black matte, no white matte, no checkerboard baked into image, no floor plane beyond the slab. Keep dark material color within the actual miniature. No characters, no creatures, no HUD, no written text, no map-name labels, no logo, no watermark.
